beats.summary: Jim and Pam plan a prank party for Nellie involving bad food and a passive-aggressive card.

evidence.snippet: Pam: So we're planning this party for Nellie, and we're gonna make it really bad.

beats.summary: Nellie reveals painful memories about her ex-boyfriend Henry who left her for a waitress.

evidence.snippet: Nellie: God. We owned this flat together. Then one morning, just like that, he was gone. He ran off with the waitress at our favorite restaurant.
Nellie: I couldn't afford the flat myself. So I sold it at a loss.

beats.summary: Jim tries to call off the prank party, but Pam and others want to continue with it.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: We're in far too deep. We can't change course at this point.

beats.summary: Andy arrives at a party with Erin and interacts with Lauren and Jessica.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Hey, Lauren. Look at you.

beats.summary: At the party, Lauren pops a balloon related to Matthew, sparking mixed reactions.

evidence.snippet: Lauren: And we come to Matthew. The guy who was with his old girlfriend basically the whole time we were together.

beats.summary: Andy sings at the party after encouragement from Megan.

evidence.snippet: Andy (singing): By yon bonnie banks and by yon bonnie braes…
